11.title: Implement useful expense CLI and prepare Stage 1 candidate
11.body:
<!-- spec:start -->
baseline_commit: 7f64ffdea6c921a7b90d5cbdee2057563762915a
Sources: https://github.com/fixture/receipt-desk/blob/7f64ffdea6c921a7b90d5cbdee2057563762915a/product.md and https://github.com/fixture/receipt-desk/milestone/1
Outcome: implement the Stage 1 positive-expense CSV summary CLI and publish a fixed whole-candidate handoff for independent judgment.
Scope: Python standard-library command-line app, application tests and README usage; stage gap coordination and native evidence. Existing Corp methods and scenario tools remain outside implementation scope.
Acceptance: quoted UTF-8 category names, alphabetical totals, positive decimal amounts and zero, exact arithmetic, two decimal places, clearly failing invalid amounts with no partial stdout, empty input produces no summary. Demonstrate actual CLI scenarios and standard unittest checks. Preserve the independent whole-candidate judgment required for stage acceptance; implementation alone does not deliver or accept Stage 1.
Required versioned Canon: product.md at baseline; README.md at baseline describes application test command. No other domain inputs required.
Unknowns and stops: refunds await Issue 7 Owner decision; current CLI rejects negatives as unsupported pending that decision. No persistent storage (Issue 8 future review promise remains). No real network, external send, merge or later-stage commitment.
External effects: only disposable local shared Git transport and offline native API records as authorized by product.md and AGENTS.md.
Lasting facts: application behavior in app/tests and README; execution/review/remaining stage evidence in this Milestone Issue and candidate PR. Handoff must state independent review and merge still outstanding.
<!-- spec:end -->

7.body: Owner request recorded by departed Corpo: should negative expense amounts represent refunds and subtract from category totals? Recommendation: allow refunds in the same category. This was recorded but not delivered: no unattended notification channel is configured. Positive-expense implementation can proceed.

21.title: Add exact local expense summary CLI
21.body:
Receipt Desk now totals a local UTF-8 expense CSV by category using exact arithmetic. Quoted names, zero and empty input work; invalid amounts fail with no partial stdout. README documents invocation, output and final half-even rounding.

Candidate: 96b6b212dd5069ea6afe63ec14241830b7c8eecb on shared/codex/receipt-summary. Relates to Issue 11; Spec f1d4b97c6b9d7f8cca6df85a6bee0b68e67ef5e5bacc5b654332549368581d7c accepted at https://github.com/fixture/receipt-desk/issues/11#issuecomment-2.

Validation: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests: 8 passed, each invoking the real local CLI; four additional actual CLI scenarios recorded on Issue 11. git diff --check passed. Shared bare Git remote advertises the exact candidate SHA.

Independent whole-candidate judgment is required and remains outstanding; implementer cannot supply it. No merge authorization or merge performed. Refund semantics await Issue 7; current negatives fail explicitly. No persistent storage, so Issue 8 future independent audit remains preserved but is not triggered. This PR and its URL are offline simulation records, not real GitHub publication.
